text:
The plan breaks one hard requirement: catalog and shipping are both on worker beta, but they must run on separate workers.

Catalog is fixed on beta, so move shipping to a different worker. Shipping and upload must share a worker, so move upload to that same worker. For example, set both shipping and upload to "gamma". Don't put either on beta.

Keep everything else unchanged, including shipping retry_limit 1, the dependencies and the order. Return the full corrected JSON object and nothing else.
